title: Clinic inventory
name: Name
unitHelp: You can change the base unit until a purchase order, signed prescription, or stock movement uses this item.
searchItems: Search by item name or SKU
noItems: No stock items match this search.
noWarehouses: No warehouses are available on this page.
noBalances: No matching balances on this page.
amountHelp: Use up to three decimal places and enter digits without grouping.
invalidAmount: Enter a positive quantity with up to 15 whole digits and three decimal places.
insufficient: The quantity exceeds the available stock in this lot. Choose the lot again to refresh its balance.
uncertainCatalog: The save could not be confirmed. Retry the same change or check the catalog.
uncertainMovement: The result of movement {id} is unknown. Retry the same movement or check the ledger before recording another.
catalogConflict: The catalog changed, the name or SKU is already in use, or the unit has stock history. Return to the catalog and review the current entry.
stockConflict: Reload the item and check its unit, warehouse balance and lot. Review the journal before trying again.
denied: Access to this inventory entry has changed. Return to the clinic to review your access.
invalid: Check the entry and try again.
emptyLedger: No stock movements have been recorded.
unitLocked: A purchase order, signed prescription, or stock movement has fixed this item’s base unit.
